title: Commonwealth Games 2026 (Glasgow): Mirabai Chanu & Sharmila Dhankar Win Gold Medals
summary: Mirabai Chanu lifts 190 kg for 3rd consecutive CWG gold; Sharmila Dhankar wins 1st para athletics gold.

blocks.content: Mirabai Chanu lifts 190 kg for 3rd consecutive CWG gold; Sharmila Dhankar wins 1st para athletics gold.

items: Mirabai Chanu Gold: Lifted 190 kg (85kg snatch + 105kg clean & jerk) for 3rd straight CWG gold in women's 48kg.
Sharmila Dhankar Gold: Gold in women's shot put F57 para athletics (ending India's 20-year CWG para athletics wait).
Silver Medals: Gulveer Singh (men's 10,000m 27:49.78), Harjinder Kaur (women's 69kg weightlifting 227kg), Sarvesh Kushare (high jump).
